release_notes:
Fix Supplier Services dropdown not refreshing on API change (package.php)

On the service API tab, changing 'Assign an API' fetched the new API's
services correctly but only did $('#supplierPackId').html(response).
#supplierPackId is a Select2 (v3) widget, which caches its rendered
selection — replacing the <option>s doesn't update the display, so it
kept showing the PREVIOUS API's service and you had to switch APIs
several times before it looked right.

Rebuild the Select2 after loading (destroy -> html -> re-init) so the
new API's services show immediately on every change. Also removed the
$.ajaxStart/ajaxStop loader binding that was re-registered on every
call (global handlers accumulating) in favour of a direct show/.always(hide).
